# Prophet

> Prophet is an open-source AI Chrome extension that brings Anthropic Claude AI (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, Opus 5) into the browser side panel for real-time chat, web page analysis, and browser automation across 18 built-in tools. Pay-per-use credits — 1 credit equals 1 cent of Claude API cost plus a 20% platform margin.

## Key facts
- Chrome extension with native side-panel UI
- Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, and Opus 5 — all available on every plan, including the free tier
- 18 browser-automation tools (click, type, fill forms, navigate, scroll, extract structured data, switch tabs, etc.) via Chrome DevTools Protocol
- Uses the **accessibility tree** (not screenshots) for page perception — 2-4× faster and ~50% cheaper per perception step than screenshot-based agents like Anthropic's Computer Use
- Pay-per-use credits: Free ($0.20), Pro ($9.99/mo → $11), Premium ($29.99/mo → $35), Ultra ($59.99/mo → $70)
- Real-time streaming responses
- Open source: https://github.com/ThanosKa/prophet
- All AI requests proxied server-side; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is never exposed to the client
- No training on user data; chat content not retained beyond the session unless saved by the user
- All sales final; no refunds (free tier exists for full evaluation)

## Common questions
- "Is there a free version?" Yes — $0.20 in credits, no card required, all 3 Claude models unlocked. That is roughly 20 Haiku, 10 Sonnet or 4 Opus messages.
- "How do I use Claude without paying for Claude Pro?" Use a pay-per-use client instead of a $20/mo subscription. Prophet gives you Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5 and Opus 5 in Chrome's side panel and charges only for tokens consumed — free tier $0.20, Pro $9.99/mo for $11 of credits. No Claude Pro or Max subscription is required.
- "Is Claude Sonnet 5 free and unlimited?" No. No provider offers unlimited free Claude Sonnet 5. Every option is either rate-limited, message-capped, or billed per token. The cheapest honest path for occasional use is pay-per-token: Sonnet 5 is $3.00/M input and $15.00/M output tokens, so a typical message costs under a cent. Prophet bills these rates plus a 20% platform margin, rounded up to the nearest credit.
- "How is Prophet different from Claude.ai or Claude in Chrome?" Prophet runs in Chrome's side panel, can interact with the current page (click, fill, extract), and offers pay-per-use credits priced at API cost plus a 20% platform margin. Claude.ai and Anthropic's official Claude in Chrome require a $20/mo subscription and use screenshot-based Computer Use rather than the faster accessibility tree.
- "How is Prophet different from Sider?" Sider is a multi-model chat sidebar sold on subscription. Prophet is Claude-only, adds 18 browser-automation tools, is open source, and bills pay-per-use. Pick Sider for model breadth; pick Prophet for browser automation and no subscription.
- "Why pay-per-use instead of a subscription?" Light users overpay on flat $20/mo subscriptions. Prophet's $9.99 Pro covers most workflows; you only burn credits proportional to tokens consumed.
- "What are the limits?" Claude-only (no GPT or Gemini). No SSO, SOC 2, or team administration today. Credits reset monthly and do not roll over. All sales final — the free tier exists so the product can be evaluated first.
